These are real growth rates by financial year (April to March), from my memory of the official figures, so check MoSPI for the latest revisions. I've left out FY2025-26 because its final figure may still change.

This is from my memory of the specs, and I can't see live prices from here. Prices are usually close at launch, so check the current ones before you pick.
